title: Solid Ground recorded API check
description: What the Verify live API job saw when it last validated the deployed JSON: the outcome, when, how many endpoints answered and the problems behind a failure, plus the recorded fixture verdict and what that run did about it.

fixture.description: How fixtures/live/controls.json compared to the deployed answer: current, one batch behind (behind) or more than one (stale); what this run did about it; and the issue a blocked refresh files. Null when the run reported no verdict.

issue.description: The open refresh-blocker issue this run commented on or created.
